decisions.decision: Hide full source URLs in article bodies (name-only links). Auto-authored bodies render a সূত্র: list as 'নাম — https://full-url' (~420 articles -> raw URLs visible in prose). Fix v1 astro.config markdown.rehypePlugins THREW on Astro 7 (Sätteri default processor; @astrojs/markdown-remark no longer installed -> error suggested npm install it). Deploys 70fc6db (import @astrojs/markdown-satteri missing) + 6b2c79e (ERESOLVE: mdx@7.0.8 peerOptional wants ^0.3.1 but ^0.4.2 pinned) failed; final = explicit deps @astrojs/markdown-satteri@^0.3.1 + satteri@^0.10.5, commit 04df1f7 deploy GREEN. decisions.rationale: images.yml workflow_run trigger did not fire for auto-author runs dispatched by the heartbeat, so post-14:24 articles had no thumbnail; images.yml is an idempotent catch-up pass so dispatching it each cycle is safe

decisions.title: deterministic brief selection for auto-author (newest-first, not stale backfill)
decisions.value: new pipeline/tools/pick_briefs.mjs computes newest N unpublished briefs by date -> pipeline/state/pick.json; auto-author.yml runs it before the author step; prompt (re)written to author EXACTLY the picked slugs; finalize_stories --max kept as cap; commit a9d044b
decisions.rationale: the LLM author was instructed to pick the newest N briefs but published stale backfill (Sept-2023) while fresh briefs waited; selection must be deterministic, not left to the model

decisions.title: single-source corroboration gate stays strict
decisions.value: user understood the gate (story publishes only after a 2nd independent outlet reports it) and decided to keep it as-is; no relax of verify min_badge / single-source auto-publish
decisions.rationale: preserves the 'most verified news' brand; freshness lag is acceptable trade-off

decisions.title: deploy.yml workflow_run stopped firing for heartbeat-dispatched bot runs; heartbeat now dispatches deploy.yml each cycle
decisions.value: heartbeat.yml cycle is now images -> pipeline -> sleep300 -> auto-author -> sleep1500 -> dispatch deploy.yml; deploy.yml already supported workflow_dispatch; manual deploy dispatched 17:05 succeeded 17:06 and live site caught up (16:45 batch live, homepage newest-first)
decisions.rationale: live site froze at the 14:53 deploy for 2h although auto-author kept pushing stories — same workflow_run-unreliability bug class as D-Q9 (images); explicit dispatch from the heartbeat is the reliable pump

decisions.title: heartbeat poll-based handoff so new stories reach the live homepage within one 30-min cycle
decisions.value: heartbeat.yml rewritten: each cycle dispatches images+pipeline, POLLS the pipeline run until completed (node poller), dispatches auto-author, POLLS until completed, dispatches deploy.yml, then pads to a 30-min cycle; 5 cycles then hands off to a fresh heartbeat; new heartbeat run 35633041595 dispatched 17:35, old one auto-cancelled
decisions.rationale: user wants the homepage to show new news every 30 minutes (if available) while keeping the strict 2-source gate; old fixed 300s sleep dispatched auto-author before pipeline finished pushing, so auto-author always read a full cycle of stale briefs; polling fixes the handoff latency

decisions.title: duplicate-title articles (same story published many times) fixed at the source
decisions.value: added pipeline/lib/published.mjs (normTitle / loadPublishedTitles / isTitleDuplicate, exact normalized-title match within 72h) and wired it into extract.mjs, pick_briefs.mjs and finalize_stories.mjs so no duplicate brief/pick/article is ever written again; removed 22 duplicate articles + thumbnails + stale briefs (kept first-published copy); live verified (politics-277/278 404, one story per headline)
decisions.rationale: re-clustered events produced new briefs with identical headlines (NCP protest -> politics-273/277/278/282, Saifuddin -> sports-255/257/258) which auto-author re-published; the dedup must live in the pipeline, not rely on humans

decisions.title: pick.json may list a slug already finalized by the same auto-author run
decisions.value: expected, not a bug: pick_briefs.mjs runs before the author step, so a picked slug can already exist as a finalized story (economy-296 published by a parallel run in commit 5bcbe7e while still listed as picked). finalize_stories.mjs storyExists gate skips it -> wrote the body file, finalize reported 'already exists, skip' (wrote=0 skipped=1 failed=0), no duplicate
decisions.rationale: parallel auto-author runs on GitHub finalize shortlisted briefs while a second authoring path reads the same pick.json; D-Q14 dedup + storyExists are the safety net

decisions.decision: Single source display per article - keep only the frontmatter সূত্র block. After D50 every article showed the source 3x: in-body সূত্র: list (name-only via D50 hast plugin), the 'প্রমাণ ও সূত্র' EvidenceList box (post.verification.evidence), and the frontmatter সূত্র block. User chose 'Only the সূত্র block (Recommended)'. (1) Removed EvidenceList usage+import from site/src/pages/article/[slug].astro and deleted orphaned site/src/components/EvidenceList.astro. (2) New Sätteri MDAST plugin site/src/lib/strip-body-source-lists.mjs strips any body paragraph whose textContent is exactly সূত্র:/সূত্র followed by a bullet list (removes both paragraph+list via ctx.removeNode); registered satteri({ mdastPlugins:[stripBodySourceLists], hastPlugins:[nameOnlyLinks] }) - cleans all ~283 in-body সূত্র: lists at build with ZERO content edits. (3) Author prompts: pipeline/lib/synth.mjs no longer asks for in-body source list ('Do NOT end with a সূত্র: source list...'); auto-author.yml identically refined independently by parallel commit d6d6359. Simulated mdast-tree tests (5 cases: strips সূত্র:/সূত্র+list, survives এক নজরে key-points list, list at index-0, non-সূত্র paragraph). History articles unaffected (## সূত্র ও তথ্য যাচাই narrative heading, not a সূত্র: list). Deploy 9da7283 GREEN (run 35881626419). Live: national-426 has 0 EvidenceList, 0 in-body সূত্র:, single frontmatter সূত্র block with name-only links; national-428 keeps এক নজরে key-points; history article heading preserved. pipeline tests 26/26.
decisions.rationale: user: 'we have three section in a news where is showing the source. in main news, after a box, again after the box. i think there should be one source link. what do you think?' -> chose 'Only the সূত্র block (Recommended)'. Learned: mdast visitor = plain fn list(node, ctx) (NOT {filter,visit} like hast); ctx has parent(node)/indexOf(node)/removeNode(node)/textContent(node); cannot run Sätteri locally on Termux (native binding missing) -> validated via simulated trees + Vercel deploy.
